instruction: I want Thunderbird to play a sound when new mail arrives. Can you enable the new mail sound notification?

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling new mail sound notification in Thunderbird. The evaluator checks if mail.biff.play_sound preference is set to true. Standard Thunderbird preference with similar complexity to original theme task.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches Thunderbird preferences file (prefs.js) from the correct profile path
Metric function (check_thunderbird_prefs) correctly parses prefs.js using regex and JSON parsing to extract preference values
Expected value (mail.biff.play_sound=true) is the correct Thunderbird preference for enabling new mail sound notification
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird to ensure preferences are flushed to disk before verification
Evaluator checks exactly what the instruction requires (enabling new mail sound notification)
All-or-nothing scoring is appropriate for this single-step boolean setting task
Metric function has proper error handling for None results and edge cases
Complete coverage: all requirements in the instruction are verified by the evaluator

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
